Usage: mcpjam cloud organizations|orgs [options] [command]

Inspect the MCPJam organizations you belong to

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  list            List your organizations and their ids (an sk_ key sees only
                  its own)
  help [command]  display help for command
